gloss: in the blink of an eye; in no time; before you know it

definitions.gloss: in the blink of an eye; in no time; before you know it
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening so quickly that it feels almost instantaneous. Expresses surprise at how fast time passed or how quickly an event occurred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あっという{間|ま}に⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The vacation was over in the blink of an eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あっという{間|ま}に⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Children grow up before you know it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あっという{間|ま}に⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧しまう⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{一瞬一瞬|いっしゅんいっしゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: Fun times pass by in no time, so I want to treasure every moment.

notes:
Literally "in the time it takes to say 'ah!'" — describing something so fast you can barely exclaim before it's over. This is one of the most commonly used expressions for describing the rapid passage of time in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あっという{間|ま}に⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to pass in no time
- あっという{間|ま}に{終|お}わる: to be over in a flash
- あっという{間|ま}に⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread in no time
- ⟦あっという{間|ま}→あっという間：10426_attoiuma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧: something that happened in an instant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in an instant — more neutral and precise; describes objective quickness
- ⟦たちまち→たちまち：07371_tachimachi⟧: in no time — slightly literary; emphasizes rapid transformation
- ⟦{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に→瞬く間に：21215_matatakumani⟧: in the twinkling of an eye — more literary equivalent

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ or {終|お}わる to express how quickly a pleasant experience ended. Can also describe unpleasant speed, such as news spreading or money running out.
